Class HoldingMoversDashboardHandler

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.dashboard.HoldingMoversDashboardHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
DashboardWidgetHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
HoldingLosersDashboardHandler, HoldingWinnersDashboardHandler
public abstract class HoldingMoversDashboardHandler extends Object implements DashboardWidgetHandler
Shared behaviour of the two cards ranking held instruments by how far they moved: one shows the top of the ranking, the other the bottom, and nothing else differs.

Both delegate to one report, so the two cards can never disagree about a figure that appears on both - the same reason the alert path shares its position calculation with the reports rather than repeating it.
